name: Ascension Parish, Louisiana (United States)
description: Divided by a white S-shaped band from the lower hoist to the upper fly, green at the hoist bearing a white sugar cane and navy blue at the fly bearing a white chemical plant, the band charged with three red stars.
history: Ascension Parish is a parish located in Louisiana. The flag was adopted on 4 October 2018 (according to Flags of the World citing The Advocate; the designer chose the sugar cane and the chemical complex as the parish's agricultural and industrial symbols).
